# Kaustubh Bagale | Full Stack MERN & Next.js Developer

> Kaustubh Bagale is a full stack developer and final-year Computer Science Engineering student at Parul University, India. He builds production web platforms with React, Next.js, Node.js and MongoDB, and has shipped systems handling 100,000 concurrent users at 99.9% uptime. Available for freelance, contract and full-time work.

## Selected work

- [Parul University Convocation Portal](https://github.com/baggiii1013/convocation-pu): Dual-interface graduation management system. 100,000 concurrent users, 99.9% uptime, Nginx load balancing. React.js, Node.js, DevOps.
- [University Admission Portal](https://parul-student-hub.vercel.app): MERN stack portal for 1,000+ first-year students; self-service verification cut administrative time by roughly 40%. MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.
